summary_1line: Bhishma praises the spiritual supremacy of Brahmanas and begins a tale of Kartavirya Arjuna whose pride challenges that hierarchy.

image_candidates.scene_text: The mighty king Kartavirya Arjuna appears in battle with a thousand arms radiating around him like a blazing sun.
An invisible voice echoes from the sky rebuking the proud king who boasts of his unmatched power.
The ascetic Dattatreya grants boons to the kneeling king after receiving his lavish gifts.
